ball_bouncy.description: Bouncy rubber ball (Ø 6.5 cm) with a tilted stripe; origin at its centre.

ball_paper.description: Crumpled paper ball (Ø ~7 cm); origin at its centre.

beanbag.description: Bean bag seat in front of the TV; makes the game corner readable at a glance.

bed.description: Queen bed with sheet and pillows; foot end is the front.

bed_single.description: Twin bed (mattress 99×190.5) built from the queen bed frame; foot end is the front. Nodes: `pillow` (throwable), `mattress` (squashes), `bed_frame`.

bottle.description: Empty 0.5 L plastic bottle; origin at the centre of the body cylinder, cap up (+z).

chair.description: B100 mesh chair, headrest removed so it does not block the monitors.

console.description: Compact game console unit; controllers are separate Xbox assets.

desklamp.description: Gooseneck table lamp; bulb is `glow`. Placed on side table and nightstand.

door.description: 99 x 210 cm panel door with a round rose, spindle and rounded L-shaped dark metal lever; shared by the entry and closet.

gamebox.description: Game case with a `cover` plane (UV 0–1, aspect ~0.6). Placed 3×, one per game.

glasstable.description: Glass shelf at the bed end (size estimated from photos).

hoopbin.description: Round office bin for the trash-can basketball game: tapered, open top, rolled rim.

monitor.description: 27" monitor; base plate centred below upright. Screen plane for paper demos.

layout.base_alignment: centred below upright; panel and screen unchanged

nixie.description: Nixie desk clock: aluminum base, 6 glass tubes (HH MM SS). The site draws digits on `digit_0`..`digit_5`.

pc_era.description: Fractal Design Era ITX (1st gen) mini-ITX case, cobalt with a walnut top (vent band and slits are print quads).

pinboard.description: Cork pinboard 150×90, wall-mounted (origin = back-face bottom center). Code pins cards on the `board` plane.

plant.description: Fiddle-leaf fig, ~0.9 m. `plant` = pot + soil, `leaves` = trunk + leaves (base at the pot rim, manifest pot_rim).

plush_sjtu.description: SJTU gear plush (traced emblem): red 44-tooth ring, raised white field with print planes on both faces.

plush_umich.description: University of Michigan Block M plush (official outline): maize face, blue piping.

plush_uw.description: UW-Madison Motion W plush (traced outline): red, thin white piping.

rug.description: Round rug, 120 cm, 1.2 cm thick: cream with a darker ring near the edge.

screenbar.description: Monitor light bar: 45 cm bar in front of the screen, `glow` strip underneath (lights the desk at night). Origin sits on the middle of the monitor's top edge.

shelf.description: Open bookshelf 80×30×150, 4 tiers (~33 cm clear). Project models sit on the tiers; heights in the `tiers` property.

tv.description: TV, 16:9 `screen` plane (108×61 cm). Gameplay clips play on it.

tvstand.description: Low TV console 120 x 40 x 50: hollow carcass, two hinged doors and an open centre cubby with two rear rows of upright game cases and a recessed middle shelf.

window.description: Left-wall window with blind; placed twice. Bottom = sill.

court.description: Compact seafoam basketball rug with cream court lines, free-throw lane and 1.32 m three-point arc. 140 x 168 cm, clear of the bed and cart.

rover.description: Transformable rover miniature recovered from all_2 CAD assembly; simplified chassis, hook wheels, motors and electronics.

quest3.description: Upright life-size Quest 3 headset only, without controllers; calibrated rigid housing and open strap pose.

calibration.note: Headset calibrated by its rigid front housing, not its adjustable strap envelope. The upright open strap is taller and deeper than the minimum adjusted dimensions; controller length uses its native WebXR profile axis.

layout.reference: User supplied front photo; three sensor capsules below centre

imu_devices.description: Dimension-calibrated phone, clean smartwatch and closed AirPods-size case on a simplified flat three-in-one charging pad.

calibration.dimension_order: width, height, depth; before the display pose

imu_devices.license: CC-BY-4.0 (phone); original watch, case and charging-pad geometry

chatbot_robot.description: Short, arms-down S-Bot figurine adapted from amanpatel9725's S-Bot: Stylized Cartoon Robot, CC BY 4.0.

robotics_vehicle.description: Bluetooth robotics vehicle (SJTU Liming Cup 2023) modelled from project photos: mecanum chassis, acrylic tower, orange lift arms lowered, foam-lined gripper. No wiring.

robotic_arm.description: ME 250 robotic arm modelled from project photos, a CAD view and notes: four red legs, motor-driven turntable gear, six columns, shortened box boom with carriage and rack, three-finger silicone gripper. Solid colours; no wiring.

keyboard_v2.description: Keychron V2 Knob Keyboard; calibrated desk prop, adapted from RelaxedImpala (CC BY 4.0); geometry rebuilt cleanly on the real 65% layout.

calibration.note: Official footprint; overall keycap height approximated at 40 mm.

mouse_superlight.description: Computer mouse; calibrated desk prop, adapted from zhe_kan (CC BY 4.0).

calibration.note: Manufacturer rigid body dimensions; loose speaker loop excluded.

jbl_flip6.description: JBL Flip 6; calibrated desk prop, adapted from polyman Studio (CC BY 4.0).

calibration.note: Manufacturer rigid body dimensions; loose speaker loop excluded.

deskmat.description: Logitech Desk Mat Blue, adapted from PolyDavid (CC BY 4.0); 700 x 300 x 2 mm.

coffee_mug.description: Original cream ceramic mug with a thick rim, open interior, coffee and a rounded handle; 95 mm high.

xbox_controller.description: Black Xbox wireless controller; Chistodrako._. (CC BY 4.0), simplified, resting face up.

phone_charger.description: Original upright wireless charging stand with a calibrated iPhone 13 Pro Max (DatSketch, CC BY 4.0), tilted back 15 degrees.

tissue_pack.description: Original soft mint-and-cream tissue packet with a folded white tissue; 180 x 100 x 55 mm packet.

tablet.description: Original black tablet lying flat, approximately 11-inch 4:3 inactive display, 242 x 180 x 6 mm body.

poster_40x50.description: Thin matte paper poster, two small top pins, subtle bottom-edge curl; no frame.

calibration.material: Approximately 200 gsm matte coated paper; 0.25 mm thick

poster_40x50.license: Original geometry; artwork supplied by site author, rights remain with respective owners

backpack.description: Original black commuter backpack by MadeByYeshe (CC BY 4.0), 430 mm body with a 10 degree bedside lean. Original UVs, base-colour, normal and metallic-roughness maps preserved; no vertex-colour replacement or mesh decimation.

calibration.basis: Generic adult commuter size; source has no manufacturer measurements

material_quality.pbr_maps: original base colour, normal, metallic roughness and hardware specular

office_rug.description: Low-pile woven office chair rug, 1400 x 1400 x 4 mm, rounded corners and stitched border.

tv_remote.description: Original slim charcoal TV remote, 145 x 42 x 14 mm with a directional pad and rubber keys.

white_phone.description: White smartphone with vivo X200 Ultra-inspired circular camera styling: silver rim, dark four-aperture disc, three lenses and a blue centre badge; face down.

headphones_black.description: Original compact black over-ear wireless headphones with padded headband, articulated yokes and cushioned cups; approximately 175 x 76 x 210 mm.

xbox_series_x.description: Original simplified Xbox Series X disc console, life-size 151 x 151 x 301 mm, upright inside the left TV cabinet compartment.

backpack_small.description: Original low-poly casual mini daypack, charcoal canvas with two shoulder straps, a front zip pocket and a small woven label; 280 mm body.

calibration.style: original casual low-poly mini double-strap daypack

ps5_slim.description: Original simplified PS5 Slim disc console, 96 x 216 x 358 mm body, upright on a 155 mm-diameter, 11 mm-high stand. Both use manufacturer external dimensions; detailed styling is approximate.

layout.compartment: left TV cabinet bay, beside Xbox Series X

snack_stash.description: A densely packed right-hand TV-console cupboard: original Snackies package artwork, Snack Bar by accidentallyc, and candy/chocolate wrappers by Kenney. CC0 sources, generic small retail-package scale, no texture downsampling.

nightstand_essentials.description: Real-scale bedside toiletries, fitness band and bone-conduction headphones.
nightstand_essentials.calibration: Mi Band capsule about 40 mm long; headphones and cream tube uniformly scaled to adult size; other toiletries approximate everyday dimensions.
nightstand_essentials.layout: Grouped on the open shelf; metres in the nightstand local frame.
nightstand_essentials.credits: Mi Band 2 by Ferran Romero bone-conduction headphones by llb and Cream tube by OlegCoder, CC BY 4.0; hand cream and eye drops original.
